documents.title: Zenith 1978 heater wiring notes
documents.text: I spent Saturday tracing the heater wiring on a Zenith with a cold 50C5. The schematic in Rider's is close but the production board routes the dropper resistor under the tuner can. After replacing the wax coupling cap on the volume control the hum dropped and the dial lamps came back. Not a universal guide — just what I found on this chassis.

documents.title: Vacuum tube heater circuits — field notes
documents.text: Heater series strings, dropper resistors, and why a cold 50C5 kills the dial lamps. Written from bench measurements, with a short table of common series-heater radios from the late 1970s.

documents.title: Three years of backyard compost — what actually worked
documents.text: I kept a notebook on carbon ratios after the first pile went anaerobic. Browns from oak leaves, greens from kitchen scraps, turned weekly only in summer. The third year the tomatoes stopped needing bagged fertilizer. Photos and mistakes included.
